blogs.title: TAV-in-TAV-in-TAV: Pushing the Technical Envelope of Transcatheter Redo
blogs.description: This post explores the technical feasibility and procedural challenges of performing a third transcatheter aortic valve implantation. It discusses frame layering dynamics, valve selection considerations for triple-stented anatomy, and the strategic decisions around high implantation to preserve coronary flow and maximize effective orifice area. The piece will examine how procedural success was achieved despite the cumulative complexity of three overlapping bioprosthetic frames.

blogs.title: TAVI After Treated Prosthetic Valve Endocarditis: When Guidelines Meet Reality
blogs.description: This post examines the controversial decision to perform transcatheter intervention in a patient with prior prosthetic valve endocarditis. It discusses the tension between 2025 ESC guidelines recommending surgical valve replacement for PVE and real-world practice in prohibitive surgical risk patients. The piece will cover infection control milestones, preprocedural evaluation to confirm resolution, and the multidisciplinary decision-making process that justified TAVI in this context.

blogs.title: The CT Roadmap: Preprocedural Imaging for Complex Valve-in-Valve Cases
blogs.description: This post dives deep into the critical role of CT-guided planning for complex TAV-in-TAV procedures. It covers key measurements including coronary ostial height, sinus of Valsalva dimensions, valve-to-coronary distance, and minimum lumen diameter assessment. The discussion highlights how detailed imaging analysis enabled risk stratification for coronary obstruction and guided commissural alignment strategy—ultimately allowing the procedure to proceed without invasive coronary protection.

blogs.title: Coronary Access in the Triple-Stented Aorta: Planning for Future Interventions
blogs.description: This post addresses the growing challenge of coronary access preservation in patients with multiple overlapping transcatheter valve frames. It discusses the cumulative mesh burden effect on future coronary interventions, the importance of commissural alignment for maintaining coronary ostia patency, and the specific considerations for patients with known coronary artery disease. The piece emphasizes proactive planning to avoid creating coronary access barriers that could prove fatal in acute coronary syndromes.

blogs.title: Patient-Prosthesis Mismatch in Serial TAVI: The Hemodynamic Toll of Valve Stacking
blogs.description: This post analyzes the hemodynamic challenges encountered after TAV-in-TAV-in-TAV, including the significant residual gradients and severe patient-prosthesis mismatch observed post-procedure. It discusses strategies employed to optimize effective orifice area—including deliberate high implantation, commissural alignment, and high-pressure balloon post-dilation—and the gradual hemodynamic improvement seen at follow-up. The piece considers whether PPM is an inevitable compromise in serial transcatheter reinterventions.

blogs.title: Lifetime Management of Aortic Valve Disease: Lessons from the Third Valve
blogs.description: This post takes a broader perspective on lifetime management strategies for structural valve disease. As TAVI indications expand to younger patients with longer life expectancy, sequential reinterventions will become more common. The piece discusses the importance of planning for failure from the first intervention, the role of valve choice in facilitating future redo procedures, and the diminishing returns of transcatheter options after multiple prior interventions—raising critical questions about what happens when the third valve fails.
